text: [link: Echo Canyon trailhead parking info, city of Phoenix]
Lot fills by like 7 on weekends so aim for 6:30 🥾
Ok early!! 😅 is 6:30 too early for everyone
6:30 is fine for me. Bring coffee
I need coffee at 5:45 then
In. Can do 6:30. On a job in scottsdale till 4 so I'll be patchy till then
Ok dinner friday, 7? I was thinking the place on roosevelt with the patio. Is it too cold for patio now
Patio's fine, it's like 70 at night. Not sure they take bookings for 6+ though
I'll call them tomorrow 🙏
Works for me
Birthday girl would like 7:30 pls
7:30 it is
That 6:30 start is gonna be cold lol, bringing a layer
Ok im going to bed. See everyone at the lot 🌙
Anyone know if the echo lot has a bathroom or just porta potties
Porta potties. Theres one by the trailhead but I wouldnt count on it
Ok
Called the place!! They can do 7:30 for 6 but the patio is first come so they cant hold it 🥲
I can ask for a table by the window tho
Window's fine. Patio's overrated when it's 40 at 6am lol
5 of us right? Me you yuki ben owen
Yeah 👍
Sorry, in a meeting all afternoon. 5 is right. Window's good by me
I can drive sat if anyone wants a lift. Leaving about 5:50
Omg yes ty. Ill be ready and have coffee in hand
I'll take a lift too if that's ok. My car makes a noise
It's a truck, the noise is the whole vibe
Reminder to bring water. First part is steep and the sun comes up fast. Im bringing 2L
Yes mum 😂
I have 1.5 already

[link: NWS Phoenix forecast, Saturday]
low of 44 at the trailhead, 58 by 8. Layers
Told you lol
Morning all. Year 2 had a fire drill during reading and nobody will say who pulled it
Was it you
I was in the staffroom with a biscuit thank you
Does the restaurant want a card to hold the table or just a name
Just the name. Under Tessa 😌
Ok 👍
Anyone got a spare headlamp for sat. Mine's dying
I have one in the glovebox. It's dim
Dim is fine, it's for looking at my feet lol
Is it bad that I've already picked what to wear to the hike and I'm not even sure what I'm wearing to dinner
Sorry that's a weird thing to send
Not weird. Same
Where do I meet you for the lift, yours or mine
Mine. Ill text the address tomorrow
Ok
No gate at echo that I know of. Just fills up
Good to know
Shower, bed, boots by the door 🥾
Boots are still in the truck lol
Ben that's not a boot plan
